detected_fault: Blank screen with keyboard lights turning on, but no display or caps lock light activation.
suggested_solution: Check the keyboard backlight connector for any signs of damage or looseness.
Verify that the display is not damaged and try booting with an external monitor to isolate the issue.
Update the BIOS to the latest version (if available) and install the latest NVIDIA GeForce drivers.
Run a system file check using the built-in Windows tool to identify any corrupted system files.
